Package model

Class HandwritingGraph

java.lang.Object
model.HandwritingGraph
public class HandwritingGraph extends Object
Represents a graph of handwriting features for a single student. Two constructors: HandwritingGraph(studentId) — standard graph for 5 feature nodes. Capacity: 10 nodes, 20 edges. HandwritingGraph(studentId, maxNodes, maxEdges) — large graph for skeleton pixel nodes. Pass e.g. 2000, 5000. Used by ImageSkeletonisationGraph which can detect hundreds of junction/endpoint nodes across a handwriting image. The static MAX_NODES / MAX_EDGES constants are gone — limits are now per-instance so the two use cases don't interfere with each other.
